title: kith-chat: Chat/changes puts all changes in created[], never in updated[]
description: Chat/changes handler puts all rows from get_changes_since_ordered into created[] and hardcodes updated=[]. The store returns (id, counter) 2-tuples with no is_create flag — there is no way to distinguish newly-created chats from chats that had last_message_at updated. RFC 8620 §5.6 requires correct created/updated split. Fix: add is_create flag to ChatStore::get_changes_since_ordered (same pattern as message and contact stores), add created_at_counter column to chats table, and split in the handler.
